citation.note: Kansas is an at-will employment state; retaliation for jury duty (K.S.A. 43-173), voting, military duty, or workers' compensation claims voids at-will terminations.

citation.note: No mini-WARN act: Federal WARN Act applies (60 days for mass layoffs affecting 50+ in 30 days); Kansas has no state-level mass-separation notice requirement.

citation.note: Drug Testing: No Kansas statute prohibits pre-employment drug testing.
Data breach notification (K.S.A. 50-7a01): trigger breach notification without unreasonable delay, typically 3-5 days; notify Kansas AG if 250+ residents affected.
Minimum Wage: K.S.A. 44-1202 sets Kansas minimum wage at $7.25/hour, equal to the federal FLSA minimum; no state-specific rate above the federal minimum.
